tasks.description: In scripts/scs001/cleanup-old-runs.ts: (1) Add legacyRuns field to CleanupResult interface: { deleted: number; kept: number; freedMB: number }. (2) In the run() function, after the entertainmentRuns block, add a new block for legacy run-* dirs: scan workspace/scs001/ for dirs matching /^run-\d+$/, sort by name descending (newest first by timestamp), keep latest 2, delete the rest using rmSync with recursive:true. Set result.legacyRuns. (3) In the summary printout, add a 'Legacy pipeline runs:' line. (4) In the JSON output written to reports/cleanup-latest.json, include legacyRuns stats. Do NOT touch any other cleanup logic.
